text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Wednesday, October 10, 2018 Posted by admin on October 10th, (PFE) and Merck (MRK). 66 points.
Tuesday the Dow was down -56.21 (-0.21%) at 26,430.57.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +6.92%.
There were 13 Dow stocks up Tuesday.
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were led by Walmart (WMT) +2.52%, Chevron (CVX) +1.59% and APple (AAPL) +1.39%.
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by United Technologies (UTX) -2.66%, 3M (MMM) -1.84% and Home Depot (HD) -1.34%.
McDonald’s (MCD +1.23%) was ugraded to ‘Buy’ from ‘Neutral’ $200.
